summary: Backend regression (10/10 pytest) and full browser e2e verified. All bug-fix items confirmed: login→logout→re-login reaches dashboard with kpi-locations visible each time; session persists across reload and clears after logout; bearer-token auth works end-to-end; scenario flow shows impact-before=82% and impact-after=12%; approve/reject show the correct success toasts; forced 503 on /api/simulation/disruption and /api/recommendations/*/decision both render the error-variant toast with class 'toast toast-error' and the detail message. No CORS console errors observed on any protected call.
critical_code_review_comments: FAILED_LOGINS is still in-memory per-process state; a restart or scaling event wipes lockouts. Acceptable for demo but call out for production.

Login success response returns both an httpOnly cookie AND the bearer token in JSON. Since the frontend now uses bearer-only, consider dropping the cookie (or at least documenting why both are set) to reduce auth surface.
server.py bcrypt-hashes the admin password on every startup when it does not match stored hash; this is idempotent but a bit noisy if ADMIN_PASSWORD env var ever drifts between replicas.
App.js is a 29-line single file with huge compressed JSX — functionally works but violates the <700 line / DRY guideline for maintainability. No functional impact right now.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, re-login, reload-persistence, logout-reload, scenario, approve, reject, forced 503 scenario toast, forced 503 approval toast)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing admin seed; brute-force test now uses a throwaway email ('lockout-canary@forwardlogistics.demo') so the admin account is not locked out for subsequent runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_control_tower.py is clean (10 tests, 100% pass). The previous CORS wildcard-preflight assertion was dropped per task note (frontend is same-origin + bearer-token auth, so public preflight behaviour is irrelevant). Lockout test uses a canary email, so running the suite will NOT lock the admin. If you re-run browser tests, remember toast auto-dismiss is ~3.5s — wait for toast to detach before clicking the next action, or you'll read the stale text.
rca of the issue: Previous iteration_2 re-login hang: fixed by frontend now storing the JWT in localStorage['ct_token'] (App.js lines 11-14) and attaching Authorization: Bearer on every axios request, plus resetting data/sim/tab state on logout. Verified by two consecutive logins in the same session reaching kpi-locations within <2s each. Forced 503 toast: fixed by introducing the 'toast toast-error' variant conditioned on `toast.error`, driven by apiError() in catch handlers — confirmed via Playwright route stubbing.
